_comment: Repository coverage policy: 100% line and branch, no exclusions.
'floor' is the enforced ratchet - CI fails below it. Raise it as tests land;
never lower it. 'target' is the policy itself and does not move.
Baseline recorded 2026-09-08, the first measurement of this repo: there was
no test project and no CI at all before. 14 tests now cover SessionLabel,
the only fully pure module in the app.
coverage.runsettings strips compiler-generated code before counting - the
GeneratedRegex source generator output and Avalonia XamlClosure types. That
is not a policy exclusion, it is code nobody wrote; leaving it in inflated
the denominator by 28 classes and put 100% out of reach by construction.
The honest reading of this baseline: the app is almost entirely untested,
and most of what remains is Avalonia views, System.Speech interop and the
Velopack updater - the parts that need real seams before they can be tested
at all, not just more test methods.
